head: 5812a267c3b94959ede42005dd73a894002f36f8
title: fix(coach): stable timeline meal paging
body:
Tier: T2
Why: one-line read-path ordering change on an existing coach timeline query; a wrong order makes a coach's food review double count entries, no data is written.
T4 trigger scan: none (no auth, tenancy, consent, PII exposure change, money, credentials or destructive data; the consent and tenant gates on the timeline are untouched)
T3 trigger scan: none (response shape unchanged; only the order of same-day rows inside the meals slice becomes deterministic)
Bounded T1: NO (touches a shared coach read path; graded T2)
Canonical builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (FIX-Q1-125, agent 125)
Parent owner: operator agent 125
Acceptance evidence: `test/coach-timeline.spec.ts` "pages the meals slice on a unique order (date, then id)" fails on main (orderBy is `{ date: 'desc' }`) and passes here; full PR CI.
Promotion triggers: any change to the timeline's consent or tenant filters, or to the response shape.

## What
`GET /coach/clients/:id/timeline` meals slice (`src/coach/coach.service.ts`, `getClientTimeline`): `orderBy: { date: 'desc' }` -> `orderBy: [{ date: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }]`.

`LoggedFoodEntry.date` is a calendar day (`@db.Date`), so every food on the same day ties. `mealsCursor` paging needs a unique order; with the date-only sort the next page can restart at the boundary day and return that day's entries again. With the `id` tie-break, each page continues exactly after the cursor row.

## Fixes (D1 from the Claude Opus 5.5 verdict on growth-project-mobile#404 @ ab6d426b)
- B-404-O1 (server half): a coach opens a client who logs about four foods a day and taps 30 on the food review; on the day where a 100-entry page ends, foods show twice and that day's kcal/macros, target percentage, entry count and average are too high. The mobile half (dedupe by id, page from the last raw row) is on growth-project-mobile#404, so the 10-07 build is correct against the current production server; this PR makes the pages exact for every caller.

## Overlap
growth-project-backend#777 also edits `src/coach/coach.service.ts` (roster activity block, a different method). This PR changes one `orderBy` line plus a comment inside `getClientTimeline`; no textual conflict expected.

No migration, no new dependency, no lockfile change, no flag.
